items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 18 at 3:00AM EDT until October 18 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Strong north to south longshore current. There is also a
Moderate Risk of rip currents expected for Pender and Georgetown
Counties.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Coastal Pender County. In South
Carolina, Coastal Horry County and Coastal Georgetown County.

* WHEN...From 6 AM EDT Sunday through Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...Longshore currents can sweep swimmers and surfers
into rip currents, piers, jetties, and other hazardous areas.
It may sweep swimmers off their feet, making it difficult to
return to shore.
items.instruction:
Caution should be used when in or near the water. Check with
lifeguards before entering the ocean for possible hazards you may
be swept into.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 18 at 2:26AM EDT until October 19 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas
7 to 10 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
